Glyphs checked with spawner_common.desc_missing per set.

cards.ids: 1..97 (pocketitems.xml: card tag 86 + rune tag 11; types tarot 22, tarot_reverse 22, suit 10, special 12, object 3, rune-typed souls 17 under <card>, runes 11 under <rune>)
cards.names: stringtable category PocketItems: <NAME>_NAME keys from pocketitems.xml name="#..."; EID section 3 (cards, 97 rows, 20 langs) via shim_eid_name_of(EID_CARD=3, id)
cards.icon: EID atlas eid_cardspills.anm2 "Cards" frame id-1 (16x20 at 75 %), the spawner draws marker "Card<id>" at CARD_SCALE 1.5

runes.ids: 32..41 (Hagalaz..Black Rune, <rune> tag), 55 Rune Shard; souls 81..97 are type "rune" under <card>

pills.effects: 0..49 (pocketitems.xml pilleffect, 50 rows; names stringtable PocketItems "#..._NAME"; EID section 4 pills / 5 horse pills)
pills.note: a spawned pill carries a COLOUR; its effect is the run's colour->effect mapping (ItemPool). Listing effects needs the identified mapping.

trinkets.names: stringtable category Items "#..._NAME" (items.xml <trinket name>); EID section 2 (trinkets, 189 rows)
